Ordinary support exposure does not certify surgical penetration, tissue mechanics, cavity feasibility, biological vessel absence or clinical injury.
Continuous axial sweeps cover full insertion and reverse withdrawal; contact volumes are cell-based exposure surrogates, not tissue removal or dose/damage.
The supplied ROI caps remain 16^3 public and 32^3 private, with at most 2 tools, 2 waypoints, 4 candidate rows and horizon 1. No full real-volume claim.

Callbacks are synchronous. Per-contact cooperative budget is not an overall hard time/memory supervisor for arbitrary selector/loader code. Zero model-forward/update fields describe the scripted protocol rather than instrumenting hostile callbacks.
Successful contact work counters are supplied by the reused kernel; failed batch reports retain null endpoints and the fixed denominator, not a complete benchmark resource ledger.

No new anatomy/QC gate is added to continuous opaque intake. Real patient execution would require separately reviewed admission, objective/estimator/policy compatibility, frame/domain evidence and supervision.
